intro: Part 3: an exception. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In a work text, identify who a rule applies to, from when, and whether it allows exceptions. «Skal» can express an obligation or an agreed plan; the context helps to determine its value.
